caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent glass vessel with a rounded, slightly tapering body and a wide mouth. The glass has a subtle swirling or ribbed pattern wrapping diagonally around its surface, depicted using fine, parallel gray shading lines. The rim of the vessel is outlined with a prominent blue band, which is the only distinct colored element in the otherwise monochromatic drawing. The vessel sits centrally on a plain, off-white or beige background, enclosed within a thin rectangular border. There is a handwritten signature, "Anna Alosbi," in the bottom right corner of the composition.
title: Tumbler
